Privacy Policy & Data Disclosures

Last Updated: October 2026

1. Explicit List of Information We Collect

When you register for a Saturday AM account, subscribe to Saturday AM+, interact with manga chapters, or make a purchase, we collect the following categories of personal and behavioral data:

  • Account & Identity Data: Your first and last name, username, email address, country/region of residence, and (only when redeeming physical prize/store bundles) physical shipping address, phone number, and date of birth.
  • Reading & Behavioral Telemetry: Chapters read, page-level reading progress (`reading_history`), favorite/bookshelf series, Hypes given, Smart Comments/Emoji reactions, banner clicks, and series page visits (`useTelemetry`) used to calculate Fandom Scores and global leaderboards.
  • Payment & Transaction Data: All credit/debit card numbers and billing credentials are tokenized and processed directly by Stripe or Shopify. Saturday AM never stores raw credit card numbers or CVV security codes on our servers.
  • Device & Local Storage Data: Browser local/session storage tokens used to maintain login sessions, dismissed notification IDs, and Progressive Web App (PWA) installation preferences.

2. Third-Party Service Providers (Sub-Processors)

We do not sell or rent your personal data to data brokers or third-party advertisers. To operate the App, we share necessary operational data exclusively with the following infrastructure providers:

  • Supabase, Inc.: Secure cloud PostgreSQL database hosting, user authentication, and serverless Edge Functions.
  • Stripe, Inc.: PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant subscription billing, 3-day free trial processing, and Stripe Connect creator tip/commission payouts.
  • Cloudflare, Inc. (Cloudflare R2 & CDN): Global Content Delivery Network and object storage for manga pages, avatars, and media assets.
  • Resend, Inc.: Transactional email delivery (account confirmation, password resets, store access codes, and creator tip notifications).
  • Shopify, Inc.: Physical merchandise fulfillment and AM Shop order verification.

3. Children's Privacy & Age Restrictions (COPPA Compliance)

Saturday AM is intended strictly for users who are at least 13 years of age (or 16 years of age in the European Economic Area and United Kingdom). We do not knowingly collect, solicit, or store personal information from children under 13 without verifiable parental consent in compliance with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). If we learn that we have inadvertently collected personal data from a child under 13, we will immediately delete that account and all associated data. Parents or guardians who believe their child under 13 has registered may contact us at support@saturday-am.com for immediate removal.

4. Data Retention & Your Right to Delete (GDPR / CCPA / CPRA)

We retain your account and reading history data for as long as your account remains active. Under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA), the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and Apple/Google App Store policies, you have the right to access, export, or permanently delete your personal data at any time:

  • Instant In-App Account & Data Deletion: You can permanently scrub your account, profile, reading history, likes, comments, and authentication credentials at any time by going to Settings → Data & Privacy Rights → Delete Account inside the App.
  • Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information: Saturday AM does not sell personal information as defined under CCPA/CPRA and honors Global Privacy Control (GPC) browser signals.

5. Digital Autographs & Non-Biometric Notice

Creator signatures displayed in the Bingo Book and on Series pages are pre-supplied static promotional graphic assets unlocked via event PINs or referrals. Saturday AM does not collect, scan, or store biometric identifiers or biometric information (as defined under the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act or similar laws) from users.

6. Privacy Contact

For data access requests, privacy inquiries, or account assistance, contact our Privacy Officer at support@saturday-am.com or publisher@saturday-am.com.
